tag.name: Captain Compliance CMP - Banner + Consent Mode

parameter.value:
<script>
(function () {
  // Ensure dataLayer exists
  var dl = window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];

  // GTM built-in variable indicating which event triggered this tag
  var ev = "{{Event}}";

  // If this is the post-click consent update event, allow it to take precedence
  if (ev === "captainComplianceConsentUpdated") {
    window.__ccConsentNormalizedPushed = true;
  }
  // If this is the page-load consent event and the normalized event has already been pushed, exit
  else if (window.__ccConsentNormalizedPushed) {
    return;
  }

  // Mark normalized consent as pushed for this page load
  window.__ccConsentNormalizedPushed = true;

  // Push a single, canonical Captain Compliance consent event
  dl.push({ event: "captainComplianceConsentNormalized" });
})();
</script>
